title: EducatesLocalConfig
description: Laptop kind-cluster scenario kind. Narrow, opinionated; empty file (apiVersion + kind only) is valid.

apiVersion.description: API version of the configuration kind. Always cli.educates.dev/v1alpha1.

cluster.description: Settings for the local Kind cluster the CLI creates.

listenAddress.description: Host address the cluster ingress is published on. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; set to 0.0.0.0 when the Docker daemon runs in a VM such as Colima so the cluster is reachable.

registryListenAddress.description: Host address the local image registry is published on. Defaults to the cluster listenAddress.

apiServer.description: Overrides for the Kind cluster's Kubernetes API server endpoint.

address.description: Host address the API server is published on.

port.description: Host port the API server is published on. A fixed port keeps the kubeconfig stable across cluster recreations.

networking.description: Overrides for the Kind cluster's pod and service network ranges.

serviceSubnet.description: CIDR range for cluster Service IPs.

podSubnet.description: CIDR range for cluster Pod IPs.

volumeMounts.description: Extra host directories to mount into the Kind node, for example to share workshop content from the host.

hostPath.description: Absolute path on the host to mount.

containerPath.description: Path inside the Kind node where the host path is mounted.

registryMirrors.description: Pull-through cache registries to configure on the cluster, reducing repeated pulls from upstream registries. The always-on localhost:5001 registry is implicit and not listed here.

mirror.description: Upstream registry host to mirror, for example docker.io or ghcr.io.

url.description: URL of the registry the mirror proxies to. Defaults to the mirror host.

username.description: Username for authenticating to the upstream registry.

password.description: Password for authenticating to the upstream registry.

port.description: Host port the mirror is published on.

bindIP.description: Host address the mirror is published on.

nodes.description: Nodes of the Kind cluster. Leave empty for the default single control-plane cluster; when set, the list fully declares the cluster's nodes and must include a control-plane node.

labels.description: Kubernetes node labels applied to this node, usable for pod nodeSelectors and affinity.

taints.description: Kubernetes node taints registered on this node (applies to worker nodes).

resolver.description: Settings for the local DNS resolver that maps the ingress domain to the cluster on the host.

targetAddress.description: IP address the resolver answers with for the ingress domain. Defaults to the host's primary network interface IP.

extraDomains.description: Additional domains the resolver should also answer for, directed at the same address as the ingress domain.

ingress.description: Ingress domain and TLS settings for the cluster.

domain.description: Wildcard ingress domain Educates serves workshops under. When left empty the CLI derives a <host-IP>.nip.io domain and serves the cluster insecurely over plain HTTP.

insecure.description: Serves the cluster over plain HTTP with no TLS. No CA or certificate is needed, so the one-time 'educates local secrets add ca' step is skipped. Maps to EducatesClusterConfig ingress.protocol http with a None certificates provider.

clusterAdmin.description: Grant workshop sessions cluster-admin access. Enabled by default for the local environment so workshops that manage cluster-scoped resources work out of the box.

lookupService.description: Deploy the lookup service used for service discovery across training portals. Enabled by default.

imagePrePuller.description: The image pre-puller, a DaemonSet that pulls images onto every node ahead of time, so the first workshop session on a node does not wait for the images it runs. It pulls the default images, the training portal and the workshop base environment, unless includeDefaultImages is false, then each entry of images as listed, an image already in the list being pulled once. Enabled by default.

enabled.description: Switches the image pre-puller on. It is the only switch: while it is off nothing is pulled, whatever the other fields say, so a list of images can stay in place. Enabled by default.

includeDefaultImages.description: Pulls the default images, the training portal and the workshop base environment, ahead of the entries in images. When false while enabled is true, images must list at least one entry.

images.description: Further images to pull, after the default images and in the order listed. Each entry gives exactly one of name and image.

items.description: One image to pull, given by exactly one of name and image.

name.description: An image's short name in the Educates image inventory, such as jdk21-environment. It resolves to the image the installation runs, imageVersions overrides included, and follows the installed version on upgrade. A name the inventory does not hold fails the deploy.

image.description: A full image reference, pulled exactly as written.

websiteStyling.description: Customisation of the workshop dashboard and training portal appearance.

defaultTheme.description: Name of the theme applied to workshop sessions and portals by default.

themeDataRefs.description: Secrets holding theme data (CSS, HTML, JavaScript) to load into the cluster.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Secret holding the theme data.

name.description: Name of the Secret holding the theme data.

secretPropagation.description: Secrets from the local cache to copy into workshop session namespaces.

imagePullSecretNames.description: Names of cached image pull Secrets to make available to workshop sessions.

imageVersions.description: Per-component image overrides. Each entry points a named platform component at a specific image, for example to test a locally built image.

name.description: Component name to override, for example session-manager or training-portal.

image.description: Full image reference (repository and tag) to use for the component.

operator.description: Settings for the Educates installer operator deployment.

image.description: Image used for the installer operator. Defaults to the image matching the CLI version.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy. When empty the chart derives it: Always for floating tags such as latest or develop, IfNotPresent otherwise.

imagePullSecrets.description: Names of image pull Secrets the operator deployment should use.

logLevel.description: Log verbosity for the operator and platform components.
